# lodash._isiterateecall v3.0.9

The [modern build](https://example.invalid/lodash/lodash/wiki/Build-Differences) of [lodash’s](https://example.invalid/) internal `isIterateeCall` exported as a [Node.js](http://example.invalid/)/[io.js](https://example.invalid/) module.

## Installation

Using npm:

```bash
$ {sudo -H} npm i -g npm
$ npm i --save lodash._isiterateecall
```

In Node.js/io.js:

```js
var isIterateeCall = require('lodash._isiterateecall');
```

See the [package source](https://example.invalid/lodash/lodash/blob/3.0.9-npm-packages/lodash._isiterateecall) for more details.
